what: Question 3: how much team ratings beyond the spread move the one-step fourth-down call (scripts/questions/q3_team_aware.py)

method.engine: M2 one-step engine; win-probability version 2; development component bundle; spread passed through to both engines
method.conversion: logit P(convert) + (team model - spread-only model) linear predictor
method.drive: next-drive touchdown and field-goal chances shifted by (team - spread-only drive model), valued through the win-probability model, where more than 360 s are left in the half
method.bootstrap: effect models refitted on resampled development games; the base engine is held fixed (its own uncertainty is M3's); Detroit and real plays also draw ratings from the filter posterior
